description: Signal Forms needs Angular 21+. When a project is older, this returns the upgrade plan as markdown, reproducing angular.dev/update-guide from Angular's own published step data — not written by this server. The current version is detected from the project; you choose application complexity (1 Basic, 2 Medium, 3 Advanced) and whether you use ngUpgrade, Angular Material or Windows, exactly as the official guide asks. Read-only: this tool never modifies your files.

fromMajor.description: Override the detected current major version.

level.description: Application complexity, as on angular.dev/update-guide: 1 Basic, 2 Medium, 3 Advanced. Defaults to 3.

ngUpgrade.description: "I use ngUpgrade to combine AngularJS & Angular."

path.description: Absolute path inside the Angular project. The current version is read from its package.json.

toMajor.description: Target major. Defaults to the version the recipes are verified against.

windows.description: "I use Windows." Swaps in cmd-compatible commands.

name: get_angular_upgrade_plan
title: Plan the Angular upgrade that Signal Forms requires
